name: Brown butter chocolate chip cookies
description: Nutty brown butter dough with pools of chocolate. Chewy middles, crisp edges.
steps: Brown the [butter](@butter) until it smells nutty. Cool it for 15 minutes.
Whisk the [butter](@butter) with the [brown sugar](@brown-sugar) and [white sugar](@white-sugar) until smooth.
Fold in most of the [chocolate chips](@chips:1.25), then chill the dough for at least an hour.
Scoop the dough, press the rest of the [chocolate chips](@chips:0.25) on top, and bake at 350°F for 10 to 12 minutes.
tips: Chilling overnight gives a deeper toffee flavor.
Pull them while the middles still look a little soft.
A pinch of flaky salt on top before baking.

attempts.notes: Good flavor but too sweet. Cut the white sugar next time.
Spread too much. The butter was still warm.
Chilled overnight. Much thicker. Still a little flat in the middle, try a bit more flour.
